**Meridian Tidal Pilot - Summary**

The primary equipment failure was Turbine T-4 taking offline on 14 March 2025 after its bearing seal corroded through, allowing seawater into the nacelle—the only failure causing a multi-week outage—with root cause traced to corrosion of the bearing seal housing. Over the 24-month pilot, 18.7 GWh was delivered to the grid, 6% below the 19.9 GWh forecast. The project finished at EUR 41.25 million against an approved budget of EUR 36.7 million, a 12.4% overrun (EUR 4.55 million) driven mainly by the T-4 repair campaign. Environmental monitoring found no statistically significant change in fish migration counts post-installation (p = 0.41). Lead engineer Dr. Ines Marchetti recommended replacing titanium fasteners with duplex stainless steel on all remaining nacelles, which the steering group accepted in principle. Final decision: the steering group approved Phase 2 for Q3 2026, contingent on completing the bearing seal redesign and a successful dry-dock endurance test.
